posts.cooked:
How's this sound? I just made a post in our news blog about an upcoming tournament here in St. Louis! It's not at the Greater Than Games HQ, but our friends at Game Nite will be hosting it. They have a great location and will make it a great time.

posts.cooked:

and by 3, does it mean like 3 people per team or 3 figures per team?

posts.name: Rabit
posts.cooked:
Although, if some of the ghosts were cut in half, each still counts as a full ghost (i.e., the five doesn't count fractions).

(And I don't think you'll have to worry about the team name - they'll work with you. )
